name: Git Links for Jira
tagline: Commits, branches and pull requests on the issue for GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps, with branch and PR creation. Free for 10 users, then US$0.90 per user.
highlights: Every commit, branch and pull request that mentions the issue key, with files changed, inline diffs, build status and how far a branch is ahead of the default.
Create branches and pull requests from Jira
Configurable branch-name templates that are always valid, PR creation on all five hosts, and a Git Viewer to browse any connected repository inside Jira.
Smart commits, only when you allow them
Smart commits are parsed and shown always, and executed only if a project admin turns them on per project and per command, with an audit line on every write.
